title: OEDS Renewables.ninja
description: Hourly capacity factors of wind (on/offshore) and solar PV for European countries from renewables.ninja (MERRA-2 reanalysis based, 1980-2016).

list.name: country
list.label: Country
list.query: SELECT upper(column_name) AS __text, column_name AS __value FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema='ninja' AND table_name='capacity_wind_on' AND column_name <> 'time' ORDER BY 1
list.definition: SELECT upper(column_name) AS __text, column_name AS __value FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema='ninja' AND table_name='capacity_wind_on' AND column_name <> 'time' ORDER BY 1
list.description: Country code of the renewables.ninja column. Offshore wind exists only for countries with a coast line (BE, DE, DK, FI, FR, GB, IE, NL, NO, SE).

panels.title: ninja.capacity_wind_on
panels.description: Wind onshore: first and latest timestamp and approximate rows (hourly, one column per country; values are capacity factors 0..1).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT (extract(epoch from min(time))*1000)::bigint as "First", (extract(epoch from max(time))*1000)::bigint as "Latest", approximate_row_count('ninja.capacity_wind_on'::regclass) as "Rows (approx.)"
FROM ninja.capacity_wind_on

panels.title: ninja.capacity_wind_off
panels.description: Wind offshore: first and latest timestamp and approximate rows (hourly, one column per country; values are capacity factors 0..1).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT (extract(epoch from min(time))*1000)::bigint as "First", (extract(epoch from max(time))*1000)::bigint as "Latest", approximate_row_count('ninja.capacity_wind_off'::regclass) as "Rows (approx.)"
FROM ninja.capacity_wind_off

panels.title: ninja.capacity_solar_merra2
panels.description: Solar PV: first and latest timestamp and approximate rows (hourly, one column per country; values are capacity factors 0..1). PV starts 1985.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT (extract(epoch from min(time))*1000)::bigint as "First", (extract(epoch from max(time))*1000)::bigint as "Latest", approximate_row_count('ninja.capacity_solar_merra2'::regclass) as "Rows (approx.)"
FROM ninja.capacity_solar_merra2

panels.title: Selected country: mean capacity factors
panels.description: Mean capacity factor in the selected range and the resulting full load hours per year (CF x 8760 h). Offshore is empty for countries without offshore wind.

targets.rawSql: SELECT (SELECT 100*avg((to_jsonb(t)->>'$country')::float) FROM ninja.capacity_wind_on t WHERE $__timeFilter(time)) AS "Wind onshore CF", (SELECT 100*avg((to_jsonb(t)->>'$country')::float) FROM ninja.capacity_wind_off t WHERE $__timeFilter(time)) AS "Wind offshore CF", (SELECT 100*avg((to_jsonb(t)->>'$country')::float) FROM ninja.capacity_solar_merra2 t WHERE $__timeFilter(time)) AS "Solar PV CF", (SELECT 8760*avg((to_jsonb(t)->>'$country')::float) FROM ninja.capacity_wind_on t WHERE $__timeFilter(time)) AS "Wind onshore h/a", (SELECT 8760*avg((to_jsonb(t)->>'$country')::float) FROM ninja.capacity_wind_off t WHERE $__timeFilter(time)) AS "Wind offshore h/a", (SELECT 8760*avg((to_jsonb(t)->>'$country')::float) FROM ninja.capacity_solar_merra2 t WHERE $__timeFilter(time)) AS "Solar PV h/a"

panels.title: Daily mean capacity factor
panels.description: Daily mean of the hourly capacity factor (0 = no output, 1 = full nominal output) for wind onshore, wind offshore and PV. Wind is stormy in winter and calmer in summer, solar the opposite.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(time,'1d'), avg((to_jsonb(t)->>'$country')::float) AS "Wind onshore" FROM ninja.capacity_wind_on t WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND (to_jsonb(t)->>'$country')::float IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(time,'1d'), avg((to_jsonb(t)->>'$country')::float) AS "Wind offshore" FROM ninja.capacity_wind_off t WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND (to_jsonb(t)->>'$country')::float IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(time,'1d'), avg((to_jsonb(t)->>'$country')::float) AS "Solar PV" FROM ninja.capacity_solar_merra2 t WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND (to_jsonb(t)->>'$country')::float IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Annual mean capacity factor
panels.description: Mean capacity factor per calendar year within the selected range: interannual variability of the wind and solar resource (wind years vary by up to +-15 %).

targets.rawSql: SELECT y::text AS "Year", j_on.v AS "Wind onshore", j_off.v AS "Wind offshore", j_pv.v AS "Solar PV" FROM generate_series(extract(year from $__timeFrom()::timestamptz)::int, extract(year from $__timeTo()::timestamptz - interval '1 second')::int) y LEFT JOIN (SELECT extract(year from time)::int AS y, avg((to_jsonb(t)->>'$country')::float) AS v FROM ninja.capacity_wind_on t WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND (to_jsonb(t)->>'$country')::float IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1) j_on USING (y) LEFT JOIN (SELECT extract(year from time)::int AS y, avg((to_jsonb(t)->>'$country')::float) AS v FROM ninja.capacity_wind_off t WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND (to_jsonb(t)->>'$country')::float IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1) j_off USING (y) LEFT JOIN (SELECT extract(year from time)::int AS y, avg((to_jsonb(t)->>'$country')::float) AS v FROM ninja.capacity_solar_merra2 t WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND (to_jsonb(t)->>'$country')::float IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1) j_pv USING (y) ORDER BY y

panels.title: Seasonal profile (mean per month)
panels.description: Mean capacity factor per calendar month over the selected range. Wind and PV are complementary: wind peaks in winter, PV in summer.

targets.rawSql: SELECT lpad(m::text, 2, '0') AS "Month", j_on.v AS "Wind onshore", j_off.v AS "Wind offshore", j_pv.v AS "Solar PV" FROM generate_series(1,12) m LEFT JOIN (SELECT extract(month from time)::int AS m, avg((to_jsonb(t)->>'$country')::float) AS v FROM ninja.capacity_wind_on t WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND (to_jsonb(t)->>'$country')::float IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1) j_on USING (m) LEFT JOIN (SELECT extract(month from time)::int AS m, avg((to_jsonb(t)->>'$country')::float) AS v FROM ninja.capacity_wind_off t WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND (to_jsonb(t)->>'$country')::float IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1) j_off USING (m) LEFT JOIN (SELECT extract(month from time)::int AS m, avg((to_jsonb(t)->>'$country')::float) AS v FROM ninja.capacity_solar_merra2 t WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND (to_jsonb(t)->>'$country')::float IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1) j_pv USING (m) ORDER BY m

panels.title: Daily profile (mean per hour of day, UTC)
panels.description: Mean capacity factor by hour of the day (UTC). PV follows the sun; onshore wind has a weak diurnal cycle (minimum around dawn, maximum in the evening); offshore wind is almost flat.

targets.rawSql: SELECT h AS "Hour (UTC)", j_on.v AS "Wind onshore", j_off.v AS "Wind offshore", j_pv.v AS "Solar PV" FROM generate_series(0,23) h LEFT JOIN (SELECT extract(hour from time)::int AS h, avg((to_jsonb(t)->>'$country')::float) AS v FROM ninja.capacity_wind_on t WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND (to_jsonb(t)->>'$country')::float IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1) j_on USING (h) LEFT JOIN (SELECT extract(hour from time)::int AS h, avg((to_jsonb(t)->>'$country')::float) AS v FROM ninja.capacity_wind_off t WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND (to_jsonb(t)->>'$country')::float IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1) j_off USING (h) LEFT JOIN (SELECT extract(hour from time)::int AS h, avg((to_jsonb(t)->>'$country')::float) AS v FROM ninja.capacity_solar_merra2 t WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND (to_jsonb(t)->>'$country')::float IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1) j_pv USING (h) ORDER BY h

panels.title: Capacity factor duration curve
panels.description: Hourly capacity factors sorted from highest to lowest: x is the share of hours in which the capacity factor is exceeded. The area under the curve is the mean capacity factor.

targets.rawSql:
WITH j_on AS (SELECT percentile_cont((SELECT array_agg(i/50.0 ORDER BY i) FROM generate_series(0,50) i)) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY (to_jsonb(t)->>'$country')::float) AS r FROM ninja.capacity_wind_on t WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND (to_jsonb(t)->>'$country')::float IS NOT NULL), j_off AS (SELECT percentile_cont((SELECT array_agg(i/50.0 ORDER BY i) FROM generate_series(0,50) i)) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY (to_jsonb(t)->>'$country')::float) AS r FROM ninja.capacity_wind_off t WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND (to_jsonb(t)->>'$country')::float IS NOT NULL), j_pv AS (SELECT percentile_cont((SELECT array_agg(i/50.0 ORDER BY i) FROM generate_series(0,50) i)) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY (to_jsonb(t)->>'$country')::float) AS r FROM ninja.capacity_solar_merra2 t WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND (to_jsonb(t)->>'$country')::float IS NOT NULL)
SELECT (1-i/50.0)*100 AS "Share of hours exceeded (%)", j_on.r[i+1] AS "Wind onshore", j_off.r[i+1] AS "Wind offshore", j_pv.r[i+1] AS "Solar PV"
FROM generate_series(0,50) i, j_on, j_off, j_pv ORDER BY i DESC

panels.title: Distribution of hourly capacity factors
panels.description: Share of hours per capacity factor class of 5 percentage points. PV has many zero hours (night), wind a skewed distribution with a peak at low values and a plateau at full load.

targets.rawSql: SELECT lpad((c*5)::text, 2, '0') || '-' || (c*5+5) || ' %' AS "Capacity factor class", j_on.v AS "Wind onshore", j_off.v AS "Wind offshore", j_pv.v AS "Solar PV" FROM generate_series(0,19) c LEFT JOIN (SELECT least(floor((to_jsonb(t)->>'$country')::float*20),19)::int AS c, 100.0*count(*)/sum(count(*)) OVER () AS v FROM ninja.capacity_wind_on t WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND (to_jsonb(t)->>'$country')::float IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1) j_on USING (c) LEFT JOIN (SELECT least(floor((to_jsonb(t)->>'$country')::float*20),19)::int AS c, 100.0*count(*)/sum(count(*)) OVER () AS v FROM ninja.capacity_wind_off t WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND (to_jsonb(t)->>'$country')::float IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1) j_off USING (c) LEFT JOIN (SELECT least(floor((to_jsonb(t)->>'$country')::float*20),19)::int AS c, 100.0*count(*)/sum(count(*)) OVER () AS v FROM ninja.capacity_solar_merra2 t WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND (to_jsonb(t)->>'$country')::float IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1) j_pv USING (c) ORDER BY c

panels.title: Mean capacity factor by country: Wind onshore
panels.description: Mean capacity factor of all countries in the selected range (sorted). Differences reflect the wind and irradiation conditions of the countries.

targets.rawSql: SELECT upper(key) AS "Country", avg(value::float) AS "Mean capacity factor" FROM ninja.capacity_wind_on t, jsonb_each_text(to_jsonb(t) - 'time') WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND value IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Mean capacity factor by country: Solar PV
panels.description: Mean capacity factor of all countries in the selected range (sorted). Differences reflect the wind and irradiation conditions of the countries.

targets.rawSql: SELECT upper(key) AS "Country", avg(value::float) AS "Mean capacity factor" FROM ninja.capacity_solar_merra2 t, jsonb_each_text(to_jsonb(t) - 'time') WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND value IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Mean capacity factor by country: Wind offshore
panels.description: Mean capacity factor of all countries in the selected range (sorted). Differences reflect the wind and irradiation conditions of the countries.

targets.rawSql: SELECT upper(key) AS "Country", avg(value::float) AS "Mean capacity factor" FROM ninja.capacity_wind_off t, jsonb_each_text(to_jsonb(t) - 'time') WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND value IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC
